title: Anyone else catching the falling knife in SaaS lately?
summary: AI fears have crushed software stocks while the rest of tech is near highs.Valuations looks attractive though, with many names at multi-year lows despite wide moats and strong margins. I started buying last week (ADBE and WDAY) and think pessimism may be overdone.Curious if others are buying here or waiting for a clearer catalyst.submitted by/u/Emergency_Pound[link][comments]
